    | timestamp = 00:33:53.960
    | text      = He's trapped largely by this fraudulent belief
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:57.200
    | text      = that he's in control.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:58.960
    | text      = I tell the Russians, I'm in control, I'm in charge.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:12.920

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:14.440
    | text      = You don't have to say it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:15.679
    | text      = Especially that angrily.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:16.920
    | text      = You don't have to.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:17.739
    | text      = If you have to say I'm in charge, you're not.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:20.500
    | text      = You're not.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:21.460
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:22.300
    | text      = That's the problem.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:23.440
    | text      = It's sad.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:24.280
    | text      = It's a very sad image because there's a,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:28.159
    | text      = when he's yelling I'm in charge,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:30.719
    | text      = what's going on is he's angry at how out of charge he is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:34.599
    | text      = Yeah, I mean.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:35.440
    | text      = And that's really what's being expressed
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:37.079
    | text      = through that anger.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:38.079
    | text      = It is like a film noir in the 40s.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:42.840
    | text      = This is when Humphrey Bogart would slap you in the face.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:46.519
    | text      = Get it together, man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:47.599
    | text      = Like that's what it would be.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:48.800
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:49.639
    | text      = Or give you a bottle.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:50.460
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:52.260
    | text      = Or smash that on your head.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:53.420
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:54.260
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:55.079
    | text      = So Alex discusses the need to defend Musk.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:58.659
    | text      = And we heard a bit about this on the last episode.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:00.539
    | text      = Interesting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:01.539
    | text      = But there's something that he says here
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:03.300
    | text      = that I think is super telling.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:05.139
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:05.980
    | text      = The Republican leadership is saying we'll teach you Musk.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:08.380
    | text      = Think you're gonna come in here with Trump
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:09.780
    | text      = and help him get his job done?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:11.579
    | text      = We'll just take everything you got away.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:14.480
    | text      = And again, Tesla's 80% of the money.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:18.619
    | text      = But you see what they've done there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:21.539
    | text      = And you know, oh the media,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:22.920
    | text      = oh Trump's getting rid of his Tesla.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:24.260
    | text      = That's not exactly what he said.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:25.460
    | text      = But this is just really sad folks and really dangerous.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:29.659
    | text      = There's a lot of other powerful people that want to be good
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:31.579
    | text      = and want to fight for humanity are watching this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:33.900
    | text      = And they're going, you know,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:34.780
    | text      = if they do this to Elon Musk, they'll do this to me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:38.059
    | text      = So I better just sit on the bench over here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:40.179
    | text      = That clip is short, but it's so key
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:42.539
    | text      = to understand Alex's continued support of Musk.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:45.659
    | text      = There are a number of reasons that Alex has given
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:47.659
    | text      = for why defending Musk at all costs is important,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:50.019
    | text      = but this is probably closest to the real one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:52.820
    | text      = Defending Elon Musk is essentially a trial run
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:55.340
    | text      = that he thinks he can entice other billionaires
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:57.679
    | text      = to support his media operation if he does a good enough job.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:01.119
    | text      = It's almost like a job interview or proof of concept
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:03.760
    | text      = that Alex's deeply invested proving can work.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:07.139
    | text      = If this media ecosystem he's built and inspired
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:09.860
    | text      = can protect Elon when Elon is acting so flagrantly
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:13.300
    | text      = out of control, so transparently corrupt,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:16.159
    | text      = then it could be a pretty useful thing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:18.440
    | text      = for other corrupt billionaires
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:20.039
    | text      = who want a media organization to defend them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:23.000
    | text      = Alex is saying that these other corrupt billionaires
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:25.519
    | text      = would love to wade into the waters
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:27.059
    | text      = of extreme right-wing activism,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:28.719
    | text      = and they're watching Elon closely to see how supported he is
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:31.840
    | text      = by the extreme right-wing media ecosystem.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:34.880
    | text      = If this media space is just gonna turn on Musk
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:37.320
    | text      = when times get hard, then how can they possibly trust
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:40.039
    | text      = that this media space won't abandon them too?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:42.960
    | text      = Slavish defense of Musk is an investment
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:45.800
    | text      = to prove to these other billionaires
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:48.119
    | text      = that you'll have their back too.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:50.440
    | text      = Alex came up in a media landscape
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:52.320
    | text      = that was all about astroturfing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:54.579
    | text      = The John Birch Society was a fake grassroots organization
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:57.239
    | text      = that was funded by giant manufacturing interests,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:59.639
    | text      = largely to suppress movements aimed at workers' rights
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:02.559
    | text      = and other social trends that hurt business interests.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:05.599
    | text      = His family was raised and suckered into that,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:09.159
    | text      = and he took that on as the real version
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:11.480
    | text      = of conservative populism.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:14.019
    | text      = In contrast to that was the predominant right-wing media
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:17.679
    | text      = that dominated the field that Alex wanted to be in,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:20.000
    | text      = namely radio.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:21.420
    | text      = Folks like Rush Limbaugh and Sean Hannity and Glenn Beck
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:24.119
    | text      = were popular, and they had audiences,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:26.119
    | text      = but their stature was greatly exaggerated
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:28.320
    | text      = by giant investments by right-wing billionaires.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:31.360
    | text      = Their radio ads were subsidized
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:33.079
    | text      = to allow for much easier national syndication,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:35.760
    | text      = and their profile was boosted by bulk purchase
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:38.239
    | text      = of their books to create the illusion
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:39.940
    | text      = that they were popular best-selling authors.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:42.280
    | text      = They were given shows on Fox.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:44.639
    | text      = All of this network was essential to elevating them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:49.000
    | text      = I was a synergy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:50.119
    | text      = It was all fake, and that was the world
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:52.079
    | text      = that Alex began his career in, but he was outside of it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:55.800
    | text      = He wasn't in the mainstream of billionaires
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:57.920
    | text      = propping up his show.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:58.880
    | text      = He wasn't allowed into these reindeer games,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:02.019
    | text      = but he was kind of playing the same game
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:04.480
    | text      = just with losers like Ted Anderson.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:07.559
    | text      = So he was doing the same thing,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:09.440
    | text      = pretending to be the complete opposite,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:11.300
    | text      = but really just being a low-rent version.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:13.880
    | text      = Sure, I mean, hey, listen,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:16.039
    | text      = everybody wants to be Dave Mercedes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:18.159
    | text      = Nobody wants to be Dave's the two used-car lots.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:21.039
    | text      = And that's Alex's two used-car lots.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:23.519
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:24.360
    | text      = So I have a theory, and this is just a theory.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:26.280
    | text      = I wanna stress that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:27.280
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:28.320
    | text      = It's something I've been feeling for a while, though,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:30.599
    | text      = and the mentality that Alex is expressing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:32.460
    | text      = after the Elon tweet really makes me think
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:34.599
    | text      = that there could be something here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:36.820
    | text      = Months ago, I said on our show
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:38.320
    | text      = that I thought someone had maybe told Alex
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:40.440
    | text      = to clean up his act, as if he were doing a test run
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:43.800
    | text      = for something bigger, like a job
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:44.880
    | text      = on a more mainstream network.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:46.840
    | text      = He stopped doing his show wasted or possibly on stimulants.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:50.099
    | text      = He lost a bunch of weight, and overall,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:52.019
    | text      = he tried to make himself much more presentable.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:55.000
    | text      = He's still often saying insane things
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:57.000
    | text      = and talking about how God gives him visions,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:58.860
    | text      = but there's less chaos, less hatchet throwing,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:01.920
    | text      = and less storming off the show
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:03.500
    | text      = when he just gets in a little bit of a bad mood.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:06.219
    | text      = I don't know if there's anyone who's actually told Alex
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:08.860
    | text      = that if he cleaned up, they would consider funding his show,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:11.760
    | text      = but I strongly suspect that someone
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:13.519
    | text      = has given Alex that impression.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:15.619
    | text      = It could be a supposed middleman, like Roger,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:18.440
    | text      = saying that if Alex makes himself a little less toxic,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:21.599
    | text      = he could get a show with Mike Lindell.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:24.159
    | text      = Or maybe Tucker has been like,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:25.420
    | text      = you can come be on my network
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:27.159
    | text      = if you just cool it a little bit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:29.559
    | text      = Or maybe there's someone like Rogan explaining to Alex
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:32.039
    | text      = that if he plays a little bit of ball,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:33.480
    | text      = there's hundreds of millions of dollars waiting to be had.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:36.840
    | text      = It's there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:37.719
    | text      = Alex knows that entire media ecosystems are buyable.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:41.800
    | text      = It's the environment that his career started in.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:43.599
    | text      = So my theory is that Alex has been convinced
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:46.239
    | text      = that defending Elon Musk is like a trial period
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:49.239
    | text      = where he thinks that he's showing other billionaires
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:51.579
    | text      = what he can do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:53.019
    | text      = And this is why the defense is so important.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:57.099
    | text      = It's very close to exactly what he's expressing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:00.480
    | text      = in that clip.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:01.599
    | text      = There's tons of other powerful people
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:03.440
    | text      = who are watching us defend or not defend Elon Musk
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:07.639
    | text      = deciding whether they want to get involved.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:10.840
    | text      = And getting involved is giving money to Alex.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:13.920
    | text      = That is generally how it works, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:16.320
    | text      = I don't know, it feels like it fits.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:18.480
    | text      = Yeah, I mean, the problem here is,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:21.559
    | text      = I think probably the problem of any,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:25.320
    | text      = I suppose it's the breakdown of all possible communication
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:29.119
    | text      = is that this is the possibility of a spawn con assault.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:35.440
    | text      = You know, like, literally my defense of this guy
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:38.920
    | text      = is bought and paid for,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:40.559
    | text      = which makes it so why would I ever believe
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:43.639
    | text      = if you were doing it just for free?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
